thread:
Sam (Sales): FYI Prospect FinTechX wants BYO-CMK + multi-region HSM failover. Requirements: rotation <=5m, rolling swap with zero downtime, audited attestation. Also need pricing per HSM op and network egress details. Thoughts?
Tara (Solutions): Do they require threshold signing or is KMIP/HSM-backed CMK enough? Also which cloud HSM?
Sam (Sales): They said "threshold" and BYOK. Peak load: 50k req/min, p99 <40ms for token signing.
Jun (CryptoOps): 50k/min≈833 rps. HSM-only signing at that latency is unlikely. Recommend DEK wrapping: KEK in HSM, ephemeral DEKs cached at edge TTL 2-5m, staggered rotation to avoid downtime.
Jun (CryptoOps): Use HKDF to derive DEKs, wrap with CMK. Keep old DEKs for grace period during rotation.
Ava (Security): Need FIPS level confirmation, attestation reports, and audited HSM operation logs. Also document key export restrictions and zero-persistence guarantees.
Tara (Solutions): For failover, we can proxy calls to customer HSM or route to secondary region. BYOK sync across HSMs is heavy. Proxy adds per-call latency and billing.
Sam (Sales): Pricing model?
Tara (Solutions): Recommended: reserved Dedicated capacity + per-HSM-op billing for proxied BYO calls. For POC we can offer metered dev calls. Must disclose egress/network costs.
Jun (CryptoOps): We can provide an eval script to show HSM-call reduction when using DEK cache (expect ~95% reduction with 2-5m TTL).
Sam (Sales): Can we share a simple test snippet for the customer to run?
Tara (Solutions): Sure — firewall allow + curl test: ```ufw allow from 34.56.78.0/24 to any port 2323 proto tcp
curl -X POST https://hsm-proxy.example.com/v1/keys/KEY_ID/sign -d '{"algo":"RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5","digest":"..."}' -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"```
Ava (Security): I'll draft Qs answers for custody, attestation, logs, rotation policy, and evidence of no plaintext key persistence.
Sam (Sales): They also want SOW fallback if HSM unavailable >30s, auto-fallback to soft-KMS in separate tenancy. Is that acceptable?
Tara (Solutions): We can but must note it's not BYO-CMK compliant. SOW needs explicit acceptance, revocation rules, and forensics.
Jun (CryptoOps): Fallback requires immediate re-wrap and rotation runbook; ops must be in onboarding docs.
DevDeployBot: POC ticket #POC-4832 created — assigned Tara, Jun.
Sam (Sales): I'll send consolidated reply asking if DEK caching + SOW fallback wording is acceptable. Thanks.
